findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded secrets
 * @description Hardcoded passwords, API keys, or other secrets in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from StrConst str, string value
where
  value = str.getText() and
  (
    value.regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|passwd|pwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token|auth).*") and
    value.length() > 8 and
    not value.regexpMatch("(?i).*(example|test|dummy|placeholder|your_|<|>|\\{|\\}).*")
  )
select str, "Potential hardcoded secret: " + value
findings.hypothesis: Checking for hardcoded secrets, passwords, API keys, or tokens in the source code

message.text: Potential hardcoded secret: The password part of this host, or `None`.
